meta.notes: Training 4, guns and the kit: the range inside the west gate (three lanes, a backstop, a lamp to shoot, a grenade pit), two men behind a dividing wall with one lit door, the armourer's hut with the range book. Regenerate: bun run tools/levels/export.ts train-kit

steps.line: Go to the sandbags: your firing point
Left button fires at the cursor. Shoot out the lamp
L is the weapon light. It shows you to them too
L again: off. The dark you made is your cover
3 is smoke. Left button throws it: into the pit
4 is the stun can: it blinds. Loud: not yet
5 is the frag: it kills, you too. Not yet
Right button fires its launcher. A head hit knocks a man out
2 again flips the launcher to its grenade
Stay behind the sandbags. Z sets the rifle to auto
Right button: the grenade, on the far wall. Loud: they hear it
Hold the left button: a burst at the lit door. It brings both men: shoot them
4, then Left button: the stun can, into the pit
5, then Left button: the frag, into the pit. Stay back
